clauses.reason: Section 2(b) originally named the Principles and Standards for Water and Related Land Resources Planning (Part 711 of Title 18 of the Code of Federal Regulations, 45 F.R. 64366). EO 12608 section 31 deletes those words and inserts Economic and Environmental Principles and Guidelines for Water and Related Land Resources Implementation Studies; the section 2(b) wording or other such planning guidelines as shall hereafter be issued is unchanged. Under the 2026-10-21 owner ruling the amendment is a later event and the clause continues, amended. EO 12608 states no separate effective date in the held text, so its signing date is used. The Code note prints section 2(b) as amended. The clause is operative.

clauses.reason: Section 4 states that Executive Order 12113, as amended, is revoked. The order states no later effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, September 17, 1981, and was performed by that act. Its effect, that EO 12113 stays revoked, continues, and the section is printed with the order in the Code note, which marks EO 12113 as formerly set out above. No held source ends or reverses it, and the claim asserts no later act. The clause is carried as operative only in that sense: it is a completed revocation whose result persists, and no ending date is asserted.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981 (46 FR 46561, September 21, 1981) was read in full from the held Federal Register original (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12322.txt, PDF page 11). The order requires agency water resources reports, proposals and plans to be submitted to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget before they go to Congress (section 1), directs the Director to examine them against three criteria (section 2), requires the advice to accompany later submissions to Congress (section 3) and revokes Executive Order 12113 (section 4). The order has no sunset or expiry. Current law: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order in full, as amended by EO 12608, as a note to 42 U.S.C. 1962, and the held eCFR text of 43 CFR 404.51 states that Reclamation's Rural Water Supply Program projects are reviewed under Executive Order 12322 to determine whether each project is consistent with the policies and programs of the President. The only later change is EO 12608 section 31 (52 FR 34617), which replaces the Principles and Standards reference in section 2(b); the Federal Register catalog and held-text number searches show no revocation or supersession of EO 12322. Bounded searches read for coverage before use: current-law:usc covers the U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted after that date and on or before 2026-10-14 are not reflected); current-law:ecfr covers the eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML; later-events:ofr_catalog covers Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6942 catalog records (1937 onward) plus operative sentences in 16784 saved order texts. These are machine leads, not independent review; the two-week gap in the U.S. Code edition is disclosed here.
